title: A New Paradigm In PTSD Treatment
subtitle: A video with David Carreon, M.D. of Acacia Clinics
body_html:
I previously written about the problem of post-traumatic stress disorder, particularly in veteran populations. You can see my prior articles on the topic here. All of us may remember how MDMA didn't do perfectly well getting through the FDA when it was brought as the combination therapy of MDMA-AT. It turns out there's more than just one way to treat PTSD. We have FDA-cleared treatments like the PRISM system by Graymatters Health, which I have deployed here at our clinic in Williamsburg, Brooklyn. We also work across disciplines regularly to develop novel treatments, and by we, I mean my colleagues at Acacia Clinics.

I have to be honest with my readers, it's like living in the future working with that team. We can take novel discoveries in neuroscience and translate them to bedside treatments in the outpatient setting more rapidly than I ever imagined. Here is Dr. , a The Frontier Psychiatrists contributor, and one of the cofounders Acacia Clinics, discussing some of our their research. It is breathtaking to work with colleagues who both care so much and work so hard to get patients well. I hope you enjoy the conversation!

Thanks for reading, and feel free to share with your friends. There is hope for post traumatic stress disorder.

Thanks for reading The Frontier Psychiatrists ! This post is public so feel free to share it.
